name: Bombay Metrics Supply Chain Ltd.
summary: Bombay Metrics Supply Chain Ltd. operates as a full-service logistics and supply chain management company, offering end-to-end solutions. Its primary services include transportation, warehousing, value-added services, freight forwarding, inventory management, and specialized supply chain consultancy. The company also engages in the manufacturing and trading of engineering tools and components, specializing in sourcing, developing, and managing supply chains for engineered components and assemblies. These manufactured products encompass various casting types such as aluminum, ferrous sand, gravity, iron, steel, investment, zinc, and lost wax, along with rubber extruding, assemblies, CNC machining, forging, stamping, rubber molding, plastic injection molding, forged heat sinks, and rubber/metal bonding. Additionally, it provides engineering services like rapid prototyping, flow simulation, 3D scanning/3D printing, and 2D/3D designs. Bombay Metrics Supply Chain Ltd. serves diverse industries, including engineering, automotive, retail, manufacturing, electrical, power, lighting, metal trading, medical, construction, transportation, and agriculture. The company operates on an asset-light 3PL business model, leveraging a global network of ISO-certified vendors and partners for efficient scalability. It utilizes advanced technology and data analytics, including integrated ERP systems, to optimize cargo movement, manage global logistics, and support the "Make in India" initiative by aiding in developing supplier capabilities within India. Its target markets extend internationally, with exports to North America, Europe, ASEAN, and other regions, serving OEMs and Tier 1 customers.
